package.name: cell_physical_events
package.description: Cell-owned physical event vocabulary on /cell/physical_events: contact, lift, release, settle, approach, engage, effort rise, motion start/stop, unknown object. Computed from the platform's declared signals (joint states, robot TF, the WatchDog camera pose topic, pad contacts when available); every threshold is config, every event carries source and confidence, and a missing signal produces no events. Python 3.10 / Humble and Jazzy.
